kernel_equivalence.restriction: Exact for a head affine in its adapted parameters with fixed features, normalization and selected weights. Joint nonlinear feature updates are outside the equivalence.

pure_variance.restriction: A variance-sensitive distribution diagnostic is not evidence of reducible squared-error conditional-mean bias. Gaussian-to-Gaussian KL is not generally the exact mutual information of a Gaussian mixture.

context_distance_counterexample.restriction: Identical input distributions and zero nearest-neighbor distance do not identify an unobserved change in the conditional future map.

H20_delayed_identification.restriction: At the current issue the two futures are observationally indistinguishable. This is a no-assumption limit on every forecaster, not a theorem that SOLID alone fails, and not a claim that H20 causes 20 steps with no new information.

context_mean_blindspot.restriction: A context-only mean gate may miss slope changes. Estimating E[R|X,C] is ordinary residual regression and requires a new learning rule/evidence before any novelty claim.

serialization_note: Initial execution passed algebra checks but JSON rejected a NumPy Boolean; cast to Python bool, with no mathematical or model change.
decision: No new algorithm supported by these observations. Keep SOLID as an established-method applicability benchmark; do not restart residual-utility memory, horizon competition or renamed standard gates.
